name: Christian Kautz
features: fair skin, light brown hair, blue eyes, youthful open face, slim build, polite reserved expression
bio: A wealthy young Swiss who bought his way into the Mercedes-Benz works team in 1937 and repaid it with third places at Monaco and Bern in his first season. Kautz returned to racing after the war and was killed at Bremgarten in the 1948 Swiss Grand Prix, on the circuit where he had made his name.
